statement: Release 11.10 primarily reorganises and connects existing climate, Earth-observation, field-context, provenance and acquisition capabilities. It does not claim a new crop-response, causal, risk or satellite algorithm.

preserved_methods.canonical_climate_dataset: Established 19-variable country agroclimate dataset retained without changing its variable set.
preserved_methods.climate_similarity: Existing similarity, explanation, robustness and analogue methods preserved; active-field reference is a transparent nearest-installed-location proxy.
preserved_methods.spatial_climate: Existing PCA/clustering/nonlinear visualisation tools preserved with clearer interpretation guidance.
preserved_methods.climate_risk: Existing risk/hazard calculations preserved; crop/season context and hazard-versus-consequence semantics are made more explicit.
preserved_methods.sentinel2: Existing Sentinel-2 L2A/STAC, SCL masking and index processing is reused; quick update is an orchestration preset, not a new remote-sensing algorithm.
preserved_methods.nasa_weather: Existing Research Data Hub canonical NASA-derived daily weather retrieval is reused for mapped-field acquisition.

new_integration_semantics.field_context: Mapped field centroid/geometry can drive environmental reference selection and explicit data retrieval.
new_integration_semantics.gridded_vs_measured: Nearest installed climate and NASA-derived values remain labelled separately from local measured sensor/station evidence.
new_integration_semantics.evidence_persistence: User-approved climate/EO session analyses can be persisted as provenance snapshots in the existing Research Evidence system.
new_integration_semantics.performance: A small process-level climate-location catalogue avoids repeated full-dataset location de-duplication.

limitations: Climate similarity is not proof of agronomic equivalence.
EO indices and anomalies are not direct measurements of yield, stress cause, crop identity or management.
Nearest installed climate reference is a spatial proxy, not a field station.
Risk/hazard outputs do not quantify crop consequences without validated response models.
